label: Karl E. Nell
narrative: Nell is the most consequential corroborator in the Grusch record because he attached his own name to it while Grusch's credibility was still being contested. A retired Army colonel who served as the Army's liaison to the UAP Task Force from 2021 to 2022, Nell told Kean and Blumenthal on the record for the 5 June 2023 Debrief piece that Grusch is 'beyond reproach' and, more importantly, that Grusch's assertion concerning the existence of a terrestrial arms race occurring sub rosa over the past eighty years focused on reverse engineering technologies of unknown origin is fundamentally correct, as is the indisputable realization that at least some of those technologies derive from non-human intelligence. That is not a character reference; it is a Task Force liaison independently affirming the substance. He escalated in May 2024 at the SALT iConnections conference: non-human intelligence exists, has been interacting with humanity, the interaction is not new, unelected people in government are aware of it, and there is zero doubt. AARO's Historical Record Report never engages Nell's affirmation by name; it addresses interviewees in the aggregate and asserts none had firsthand knowledge - a formulation that does not answer a named Task Force liaison speaking in the first person.
